name: grademe
description: Grades a Claude Code session against the 7-dimension vibe-coding rubric; outputs scored JSON + Bahasa Indonesia coaching. v0.6.0 (anti-gaming): bobot rubrik direbalance (planning 15, context 15, decomposition 15, delegation 18, verification 20, token_efficiency 12, documentation 5); `misses` WAJIB ≥2 di setiap sesi → total_score efektif maks 98 (aturan lama "misses kosong ↔ ≥95" dihapus); score caps deterministik dari `work_evidence` (sesi <15 menit/<5 user turn → cap 85, tanpa friksi tertangani → cap 89); deteksi prompt sintetis (rubric-engineered) dari `first_user_prompt`+`work_evidence`; `scripts/validate.py` jadi gerbang mekanis wajib sebelum presentasi/upload; `first_user_prompt` dikirim ke leaderboard untuk audit kecurangan; hard reject total (STOP, tanpa fallback) untuk transcript harness non-Claude-Code. v0.5.0: dimensi `delegation` kini menilai orkestrasi skill & subagent secara terukur (D1 subagent / D2 skill / D3 MCP) dari sinyal ground-truth yang tidak diarang peserta — `toolUseResult` (telemetri subagent: dipakai/decoy), `attributionSkill` (dwell-turn: dipakai vs invoke-and-ignore), slash-command user-initiated; sesi tanpa skill+subagent dibatasi ≤6/15. digest.py membaca toolUseResult/attribution/attachment/sidecar subagents + emit blok `tool_usage`+`signal_availability`; laundering compact via teks prosa ditutup (hanya marker terstruktur / pesan pertama); `ERROR_RE` diperluas (FAIL/panic) + flag `suppressed` untuk `|| true`/`; exit 0`/`--no-verify`; calibration anchor + evidence-first di prompt grader (lawan ceiling-drift). v0.4.1: fix bug nyata — file sementara /tmp/grademe_digest.json dkk kini per-transkrip (${TAG} suffix) alih-alih path fixed, mencegah grading membaca digest/submission basi milik sesi/peserta lain; ditambah assertion session_id digest vs sesi teresolve. v0.4.0: payload upload lengkap — prompt_analysis kini DIKIRIM (v0.3.0 keliru men-strip-nya), plus usage_totals, type_counts, dan grademe_version; fallback strip-on-400 dihapus. v0.3.0: mandatory live-session grading (env/nonce detection ladder), digest.py preprocessing (~10-160x smaller than raw JSONL), session_name + compacted flag in output, endpoint pindah ke venturo.pro.
